content.title: Value earns disclosure
content.summary: Decision-owning leaders will share enough real context when the immediate value exchange is clear.

content.title: Five-minute honest value
content.summary: A five-minute loop can deliver a useful decision improvement without fake certainty.

content.title: Three doors reduce burden
content.summary: Three plain-language entry doors reduce state mismatch more than they add choice friction.

content.title: Tap-first can preserve nuance
content.summary: Low-effort taps can preserve nuance when combined with contrastive follow-ups and optional voice.

content.title: Engagement is best proving ground
content.summary: The Mindmake 30-day engagement produces better learning density than immediate broad self-serve launch.

content.title: Public redacted snapshot is acceptable
content.summary: A summary-only public Git snapshot gives useful audit and recovery without exposing sensitive strategy.

content.title: Integration beats rewrite
content.summary: Existing CTRL primitives are sound enough that integration and simplification will outperform a ground-up rewrite.

content.title: Decision available in seven days
content.summary: A useful live or safely guided consequential decision can be found within the first week for most qualified users.

content.title: Return pull predicts recurring value
content.summary: Return pull is a provisional leading signal, not ultimate proof.

content.title: Relationship-embedded product advantage
content.summary: Relationship-embedded value is the provisional first adoption wedge.

content.title: One coherent AI-transition decision substrate
content.summary: The five initial decision families are provisionally treated as one coherent substrate.

content.title: Target leaders value founder-style richness
content.summary: Founder preference for rich elicitation remains a target-user hypothesis.

content.title: Harness live versus diagnostic unvalidated
content.summary: The corpus says all harness stages are live while recording an undone mandatory hand-run, empty peer corpus, and provisional thresholds.

content.title: Voice and time promise drift
content.summary: Canonical prose says intake supports voice or text and forbids unmeasured completion claims; shipped onboarding has no voice path and renders an about-three-minutes claim.

content.title: Trust copy versus storage reality
content.summary: Compressed trust language says encrypted and only the user can see it, while architecture admits plaintext fields and privileged operator/service access.

content.title: First mistake versus recurrence threshold
content.summary: Doctrine says the same mistake should not happen twice, while one learning path waits for four recurrences.

content.title: Independent review versus self-authored correction
content.summary: The corpus forbids a worker grading its own work, but some flows let the same model infer root cause and propose the rule.

content.title: Voice imitation versus judgement scaffold
content.summary: One method seeks output indistinguishable from the user while founder evidence prefers a neutral scaffold preserving the leader’s first and last judgement.

content.title: Commit-first versus option-led
content.summary: One framework withholds the verdict until user commitment, while founder evidence prefers option-led contextual guidance over a universal ritual.

content.title: Covert learning versus consent
content.summary: One prompt asks for subtle or covert capture while the strongest product flow requires visible confirmation and revocation.

content.title: Competing product centres
content.summary: Briefing, clarity engine, decision cockpit, Kit, Automator, Memory, and export have each been treated as the product centre.

content.title: Retrieval frequency versus truth
content.summary: A proposed memory signal treats reference count as intelligence, although retrieval frequency measures exposure rather than truth, usefulness, endorsement, or outcome.

content.tension: Feeling deeply understood can coexist with worse advice.
content.required_resolution: Treat warmth as an experience quality and independent judgement as a separately tested invariant.

content.title: Private brain versus company/advisor visibility
content.summary: Private ownership and company value are stitched through separate assets and explicit transfer rules.

content.title: Quiet learning versus silent durable mutation
content.summary: Low-friction learning is preserved without silent durable identity mutation.

content.title: Adaptive magic versus evaluability
content.summary: Adaptive orchestration must remain measurable through typed claims and held-out evaluation.

content.title: Interestingness versus attention protection
content.summary: Interestingness alone cannot authorize interruption; materiality and attention budget remain to be tested.

content.title: Operating-model evidence versus personnel action
content.summary: Evidence for an AI-native operating model must not be used as a shortcut to judgments about particular people.

content.title: Primary user
content.summary: The primary v1 user is a decision-owning leader.

content.title: CTRL commercial role
content.summary: CTRL initially serves as the client engine for Mindmake’s 30-day proof, not as a third public offer.

content.title: Adaptive interview depth
content.summary: Interview depth is earned adaptively through engagement rather than imposed or hidden behind an advanced setting.

content.title: Durable discovery continuity
content.summary: No material answer, final decision, assumption, contradiction, evidence item, or unresolved question may live only in conversational memory; milestone progress is tracked separately.

content.title: Discovery source of truth
content.summary: Canonical discovery state is append-only Supabase data with a deterministic redacted Git snapshot, not two competing sources of truth.

content.title: Seven-day proof
content.summary: The seven-day proof is that CTRL materially sharpens one real consequential decision.

content.title: Diagnostic claim discipline
content.summary: Until predictive and longitudinal validation exists, present CTRL as an inspectable working model or judgement map, not a validated diagnostic.

content.title: First-session time bargain
content.summary: The first-session promise is five useful minutes followed by optional depth that must keep earning attention.

content.title: Joint reasoning purpose
content.summary: CTRL’s purpose is to help leaders reach and own the right decision themselves, strengthening both human and AI reasoning, rather than vend an answer.

content.title: Timing of CTRL’s view
content.summary: CTRL may reveal its evidence-backed preferred path only after the user has formed a provisional view; the user owns the final call.

content.title: Three human entry doors
content.summary: The entry experience offers three human doors: guided help, something specific, or a quick exercise.

content.title: Mobile interaction balance
content.summary: On phone, the default interaction is tap-first with voice immediately available and typing optional.

content.title: V1 proving-ground sequence
content.summary: Strategic forks first, product and quality calls second, people decisions third.

content.title: Work-first personal scope
content.summary: Begin with work; invite personal context only when relevance is clear to the user.

content.title: Evidence-adaptive recognition
content.summary: Surface whichever supported recognition fits the case; never manufacture a fixed aha.

content.title: Production trust containment authorized
content.summary: Staged containment and adversarial verification are authorized within the recorded non-deletion boundary.

content.title: Immediate visible founder questions
content.summary: Founder-alignment questions must appear immediately in a reliably visible format; native interactive controls are preferred only when dependable, and persistence or QA must never delay the next question.

content.title: Early value signal
content.summary: Within seven days, CTRL's signature value is surfacing an unarticulated criterion or tension strongly enough that the user wants to return.

content.title: Insufficient-evidence behavior
content.summary: When evidence is insufficient, CTRL should name the precise gap and propose the smallest uncertainty-reducing experiment.

content.title: Engagement value stack
content.summary: During the thirty-day proof, CTRL should primarily improve joint client–Krish work and strengthen Krish backstage; solo client use earns its place only when nearly effortless and additive between sessions.

content.title: Return loop priority
content.summary: CTRL earns return through remembered and reframed continuity, a better next Mindmake session, and a tiny action or experiment that creates movement, in that order.

content.title: Bounded AI-transition territory
content.summary: CTRL v1 is a decision companion for how AI changes the leader's category, organization, staff and own role—not a general-purpose business decision tool.

content.title: Capability-to-company value chain
content.summary: CTRL builds the leader's personal AI-era capability as the mechanism for better category and organizational outcomes paid for by the company.

content.title: Initial decision-family boundary
content.summary: CTRL's initial families are AI/human work allocation, role and responsibility redesign, leader adaptation, move-now-versus-wait pacing, and continuation/change/termination of AI initiatives; it may discuss work design but not evaluate named people or recommend employment actions.

content.title: First wedge and company outcomes
content.summary: Lead with leader stop/start/delegate/learn/excellence choices, then organization now/next/not-yet pacing; include live initiative triage conditionally, and prove value through held-back decision performance, reinvested capacity, leader independence, staff agency and a defensible transition map.

content.title: Two separately permissioned assets
content.summary: CTRL must maintain a leader-owned Private Leader Brain and a company transition map as distinct assets with separate permissions.

content.title: Adaptive evidence orchestration
content.summary: CTRL should flexibly orchestrate available, consented evidence and do the heavy lifting, asking only the lowest-friction question that materially changes the active decision.

content.title: Transcript context-quality lifecycle
content.summary: Meeting transcripts may enter through explicit selection, clearly consented automatic ingestion, and derived summaries, but reasoning must preserve speaker, time, decision, surrounding context and provenance while minimizing third-party data and rechecking source context before consequential conclusions.

content.title: Private-to-company and advisor flow
content.summary: Deliberately formed non-personal company insights may flow visibly into the company map and useful insights may normally flow to Krish, but ambiguous material stays private and off-the-record mode creates no durable write, later inference, use or disclosure.

content.title: Decision-quality proof hierarchy
content.summary: Primary proof is performance on held-back new AI-transition decisions, followed by reinvested capacity, an evidence-backed now/next/not-yet map and staff clarity/agency; return desire is a leading adoption signal, not outcome proof.

content.title: Progressive whole-brain learning
content.summary: The Private Leader Brain should learn all nine selected dimensions progressively from real work: evidence standards, decision posture, AI/human boundaries, protected values, development choices, stated-versus-revealed conflict, people leadership, taste, and durable corrections.

content.title: Confidence- and consequence-gated learning
content.summary: Consented evidence may be captured quietly and low-stakes inferences may update provisionally, but influential, sensitive or durable claims require stronger evidence or user confirmation before becoming active brain truth.

content.title: Contradiction and correction protocol
content.summary: CTRL preserves conflicting evidence with context, asks one precise question, runs the smallest discriminating test when useful, escalates unresolved conflict to Krish, and after correction repairs all downstream conclusions and memory without apology theatre.

content.title: Minimum helpful interruption
content.summary: CTRL should prepare silently from consented evidence and proactively interrupt only when the smallest one-click or voice interaction can materially improve an active AI-transition decision or relationship moment.

content.title: Signature magic sequence
content.summary: CTRL's signature experience is to anticipate the next tension, remember what mattered, improve the next Mindmake session, convert thought into a useful one-tap action or artifact, learn corrections permanently, connect category/company/self, and sharpen vague AI concern into a precise decision.

content.title: Complete docs audit
content.summary: Every file in the repository’s /docs corpus was assigned and read in full at the pinned commit; findings were separated into current product, theory, and historical/operational layers.

content.title: Mindmake anchor
content.summary: Current Mindmake positioning says every AI knows the market but not the leader; CTRL remains the hidden engine beneath two public doors and one 30-day proof.

source_ref: mindmake.co live and krishanraja/mindmake current canon

content.title: Existing product assets
content.summary: The repository already contains strong temporal memory, provenance, relationship edges, decision lineage, consent checks, comparative elicitation, evaluation, and skill packaging primitives.

content.title: No GitHub brain export
content.summary: The current product has no executable GitHub repository creation, commit, push, or sync path; context export is a flat derivative and skill ZIP/MCP are separate.

content.title: Self-healing stops before application
content.summary: The current capture flow detects recurrence and records proposal acceptance but does not apply a criteria version, deploy it, or prove rollback and effect.

content.title: Export contamination
content.summary: Current export can include unverified facts and emerging patterns without surfaced provenance, and adapters inject generic house conventions as though they belong to the user.

content.title: Elicitation research
content.summary: Critical incident reconstruction, Repertory Grid contrasts, and Best-Worst Scaling support richer elicitation than generic self-description, with known fatigue, order, and context effects.

content.title: Long-memory research
content.summary: Benchmarks expose failures in temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, conflict resolution, selective forgetting, and abstention; summaries can lose preference signals.

content.title: Identity and autobiographical memory
content.summary: Human identity is contextual and evolving, and autobiographical memory is reconstructive and goal-shaped rather than a settled fact database.

content.title: Reliance and governance
content.summary: Quality depends on appropriate human-AI reliance, while inferred personal data requires provenance, purpose limitation, correction, and deletion boundaries.

content.title: Protected Git branch
content.summary: A dedicated Git branch was created from the exact audited commit before any ledger file was written.

content.title: Authenticated storage target
content.summary: The healthy Supabase project used by CTRL was verified by stable ref; the ctrl_discovery namespace did not exist before migration.

content.claim: Adaptive probes can enrich specificity, but they spend time and goodwill.
content.implication: Return value after one or two asks and deepen only when uncertainty matters.

content.claim: Comparisons often yield strong signal, but no comparison format is universally easiest.
content.implication: Make adaptive contrast central and full ranking optional.

content.claim: Real incidents and concrete contrasts reveal judgement cues that abstract values questions often miss.
content.implication: Begin with something real and store the resulting construct as provisional evidence.

content.claim: A preference answer and its explanation are contextual evidence, not timeless identity truth.
content.implication: Preserve provenance and test generalisations across contexts.

content.claim: Active learning reduces redundant queries, but information gain alone is not a humane interview policy.
content.implication: Charge every question for effort, sensitivity, repetition, and value debt.

content.claim: Depth must be staged, but a progress bar is not a substitute for value.
content.implication: Show completed outcomes and offer more depth on demand.

content.claim: Forced comparison can manufacture signal.
content.implication: Offer uncertainty exits and capture what the answer depends on.

content.claim: Mobile and voice change effort and privacy expectations; neither is universally superior.
content.implication: Use tap-first mobile and optional, editable, explicitly persistent voice.

content.claim: Memory quality is multidimensional; recall alone is an unsafe North Star.
content.implication: Evaluate temporal correctness, updating, abstention, forgetting, retrieval, and application separately.

content.claim: Every changing assertion needs separate world-valid time and system-record time.
content.implication: Support both what was true then and what CTRL knew then.

content.claim: Storage must never launder an inference into a fact or repetition into authority.
content.implication: Carry attribution, scope, provenance, and epistemic class through every promotion.

content.claim: Canonical evidence and current interpretation are different layers.
content.implication: Preserve version history; rebuild the present view; keep purge as a separate governed operation.

content.claim: Not every inconsistency is a contradiction.
content.implication: Type direct conflict, change over time, scope divergence, and source disagreement separately.

content.claim: A summary is a lossy view, not a replacement for evidence; forgetting is not the same as deletion.
content.implication: Keep provenance-linked syntheses and distinct states for supersession, inactive history, archive, and purge.

content.claim: Correction is a propagation event, not a hidden edit.
content.implication: Preserve lineage, invalidate dependencies, rebuild current views, and restrict disputed use.

content.claim: Self-healing is governed release management, not autonomous self-rewriting.
content.implication: Propose, test independently, approve by risk, monitor, and preserve exact rollback.

content.claim: Human-first sequencing protects independence more reliably than it improves accuracy.
content.implication: Capture a soft provisional view with a legitimate no-informed-view path.

content.claim: Useful friction behaves like a dosage, not a permanent ritual.
content.implication: Trigger a short challenge when decision risk justifies it.

content.claim: An explanation can be persuasion; verifiability is the useful mechanism.
content.implication: Expose evidence and assumptions rather than certainty theatre or hidden reasoning.

content.claim: Confidence displays change behaviour and are unsafe when unvalidated.
content.implication: Prefer named uncertainty and evidence state; reserve numbers for empirically calibrated decision classes.

content.claim: Trust and agreement are not decision quality.
content.implication: Measure correct acceptance and correct resistance separately.

content.claim: Always having an answer is a defect.
content.implication: CTRL must be able to ask, experiment, abstain, and escalate.

content.claim: A good outcome does not prove a good decision.
content.implication: Freeze the ex-ante record and score process and outcome separately.

content.claim: Provenance, correction, contestability, override, and clear AI identity are baseline controls.
content.implication: Make why and that is wrong first-class interactions.

content.claim: Felt understood can rise while judgement worsens.
content.implication: Warmth must never displace independent epistemic judgement; warning labels alone are insufficient.

content.claim: CTRL-specific durable benefit is not yet proven.
content.implication: Require longitudinal field evidence before claiming improved judgement or a validated diagnostic.

content.title: Interactive G2 control verified
content.summary: Ordered ranking, qualifiers, nuance, review/edit, submission composition, 320px touch layout and a clean console passed; target-user preference remains unproven.

content.title: Founder-alignment synthesis through G10
content.summary: CTRL's coherent wedge is relationship-embedded AI-transition decision support that compounds leader-owned capability and separately governed company value.

content.title: Contrastive interview value
content.summary: Stack-ranked, pairwise, and contrastive interaction can elicit unusually rich judgement data quickly when every deeper turn produces immediate visible value.

content.title: State-adaptive opening
content.summary: A single prescribed opening is inferior to an entry that adapts to present clarity, energy, and input constraints without assigning a fixed personality type.

content.status: Provisional until CTRL-specific experiments show better held-out judgement fidelity without unacceptable burden.
content.hypothesis: Earn depth through a loop of real context, one small contrast, immediate reflection, correction, and optional continuation.
content.key_guardrail: The brain is durable residue of delivered value, not a questionnaire completion target.

content.hypothesis: Build the brain as provenance-linked evidence plus rebuildable current views, with independent axes for truth status, time, permission, lifecycle, and retrieval.

content.status: Provisional until governance thresholds are locked.
content.hypothesis: Fluid learning is compatible with strict durable authority only when promotion is evidenced, scoped, tested, approved, versioned, monitored, and reversible.
Soft human-first signal → independent AI pass → verifiable reconciliation → user-owned decision.
Optimise process quality, two-sided appropriate reliance, agency, and unaided capability.
Use reflective friction as a risk-scaled dosage, not a fixed ceremony.

content.title: Hidden marketing-system question
content.summary: The real strategic question may be where exceptional human judgment remains after AI absorbs production and coordination.

content.summary: The complete /docs corpus was inventoried and read at the pinned commit.

content.title: Mindmake positioning audit
content.summary: The live site and current business canon were read and reconciled.

content.summary: The private append-only discovery schema and classified seed records are created atomically.

content.summary: The deterministic redacted snapshot, SHA-256 sidecar, public schema projection, and README passed exact Git fetch readback.

content.title: Founder product interview
content.summary: G1 is complete. The proof-signal, uncertainty behavior, and 30-day value-location batch is awaiting answers.

content.title: Decision-complete product plan
content.summary: Experience, ontology, governance, evaluation, export, migration, and rollout remain to be locked.

content.title: Product implementation
content.summary: No product implementation has begun; persistence is deliberately first.

content.statement: Emergency containment is live and verified. Frontend deployment, wider coverage, careful restoration, and complete erasure assurance remain.

content.title: Founder alignment captured through G10
content.summary: Founder alignment through G10 is durably captured and ready for the next product-design questions.

content.title: G11 real-decision loop
content.summary: The first real five-minute decision loop is underway.

content.title: First v1 decision domain
content.summary: Strategic forks first; product and quality calls second; people decisions third.

content.title: Personal scope
content.summary: Work first; invite personal context when its relevance is clear.

content.title: Canonical brain ontology
content.summary: Which objects are first-class in v1: constitution, current chapter, taste, decision journal, chronicle, hypotheses, learning ledger, relationships, and skills?

content.title: Inference boundaries
content.summary: What may be inferred silently, proposed for confirmation, explicitly required, or never inferred?

content.title: Self-healing authority
content.summary: Which steps may automate across detection, demotion, question, proposal, independent eval, accepted application, release, and rollback?

content.title: User brain export
content.summary: Should users receive ZIP, OAuth private repo, commits/PRs, scheduled snapshots, import, or bidirectional sync?

content.title: Surviving product surfaces
content.summary: Which of Today, Briefing, Decide, Blind Spot, Memory, and the hidden harness remain primary, supporting, or retired?

content.title: Privacy, portability and deletion
content.question: What exact, plain-language lifecycle contract covers access, export, correction and erasure across account and pre-account identities, source records, derived views, caches, storage, subscriptions, vendors, logs, backups and Git copies?

content.title: Recognition moment
content.summary: Adapt the recognition to the strongest supported hidden criterion, tension or choice.

content.title: Weekly return
content.summary: What natural event brings a decision-owning leader back without manufactured engagement?

content.title: Taste validation
content.summary: What held-out real-work task and error bound proves the taste model predicts this person’s judgement?

content.title: Decision quality
content.summary: How will CTRL separate good process from lucky outcome and measure combined human-plus-AI improvement?

content.title: Commercial handoff
content.summary: How should software value convert into or extend Mindmake’s 30-day engagement without becoming a third offer?

content.title: Provider minimisation
content.summary: Which existing model, search, and voice providers are justified for a private brain, and what reduced-provider modes are needed?

content.title: Migration posture
content.summary: Should evolution preserve current users/data/navigation through stages, or permit a cleaner reset?

content.title: Anonymous-user trust boundary
content.question: What data and capabilities are allowed before account continuity is proven, and how are temporary records isolated, claimed, expired, exported, and deleted?

May CTRL show numeric AI confidence before it is calibrated for that decision class?

content.recommended_default: Strategy and product first; regulated and consequential people recommendations require a separate governance path.

content.question: Will improved-judgement and diagnostic claims wait for an 8–12-week real-leader trial?

content.title: Production trust-containment authorization
content.summary: Founder authorized staged containment and adversarial verification within the recorded non-deletion boundary.

content.title: Seven-day proof signals
content.summary: B is the sole selected proof signal: CTRL surfaces an unarticulated criterion or tension. Desire to return is a necessary adoption signal, not a substituted second proof outcome.

content.title: Best insufficient-evidence result
content.summary: A and B are tied: name the precise missing information and propose the smallest uncertainty-reducing experiment.

content.title: Thirty-day value location
content.summary: Value is primarily felt in client-plus-Krish sessions and backstage strengthening of Krish; solo use is conditional on being exceptionally fast, obvious and additive between check-ins.

content.title: Reason to return
content.summary: Return pull is earned in order by remembered/reframed continuity, a better next session with Krish, and a tiny action or experiment that creates movement.

content.title: Between-session jobs
content.summary: The job ranking is deliberately deferred until CTRL's supported AI-transition decision territory is narrowed.

content.title: What flows to Krish
content.summary: Useful information should normally flow to Krish automatically, subject to the later separate-asset, permission and off-the-record contract.

content.title: Company value and personal capability
content.summary: C is the capability engine; A and B are the paid company outcomes. CTRL makes the leader more capable of navigating category and organizational change.

content.title: Initial AI-transition decision families
content.summary: Selected decision families, in stated order, are work allocation, role redesign, leader adaptation, pace, and current AI initiative continuation/change/termination.

content.title: People-decision boundary
content.summary: CTRL may support work and role design but must not evaluate named individuals or recommend employment actions.

content.title: First decision wedges
content.summary: Lead with leader adaptation, then organization pacing; include live AI initiative triage only conditionally.

content.title: Thirty-day company outcomes
content.summary: Company outcomes rank: reinvested leader capacity, repeatable independent decision capability, staff clarity and agency, then a defensible now/next/not-yet plan.

content.title: Brain ownership model
content.summary: CTRL should create two explicitly separated, separately permissioned assets: the leader-owned Private Leader Brain and the company transition map.

content.title: Best entry inputs
content.summary: Entry inputs rank outside-in evidence first, then a broad AI-transition need that CTRL sharpens, then the leader's actual week and attention.

content.title: Private-to-company crossing
content.summary: Deliberately formed non-personal business insights may cross automatically with visibility and undo; ambiguous material stays private because undo cannot unshare.

content.title: Day-30 evidence hierarchy
content.summary: Proof ranks held-back new decision performance, capacity shift, an evidence-backed transition map, then staff clarity and agency.

content.title: First five-minute opening
content.summary: Open with three human doors, then use an evidenced category shift, a three-force horizon, and guided category/organization/self diagnosis as appropriate.

content.title: What the private brain learns
content.summary: All nine dimensions belong, learned progressively through real work rather than through exhaustive upfront intake.

content.title: Krish visibility and off-record mode
content.summary: Useful insights normally flow to Krish automatically, with a genuine off-the-record mode that creates no durable write, later inference, use or disclosure.

content.title: Evidence weighting
content.summary: No universal source hierarchy is chosen. Evidence weight must be claim-type-specific and constrained by what can be acquired easily, consensually and with minimal bias.

content.title: How learning updates
content.summary: Evidence capture may be quiet under clear consent; inferences update provisionally; influential or sensitive durable claims require confidence- and consequence-sensitive confirmation.

content.title: Contradiction sequence
content.summary: Contradictions are handled in order: preserve contextualized versions, ask the person, run the smallest discriminating test, then bring unresolved conflict to Krish.

content.title: Default input bundle
content.summary: There is no compulsory source bundle: CTRL adaptively orchestrates available consented evidence and asks only the lowest-friction question capable of changing the decision.

content.title: Transcript treatment
content.summary: Use selected-session sharing, clearly consented automatic ingestion, and a derived layer together, with source context quality treated as sacrosanct.

content.title: Active prompting style
content.summary: Prompts should be dynamically timed like a thoughtful working partner: predictive, prepared, one-click or voice, and limited to the smallest interruption that materially changes understanding or action.

content.title: Signature magic moments
content.summary: Magic moments rank anticipation, continuity, improved human session, one-tap conversion to action, durable correction, cross-level connection, then decision sharpening.

content.title: Acceptable proactive triggers
content.summary: Selected proactive triggers are before a Mindmake session, material new category evidence, apparent stuckness or silence, and whenever CTRL finds something interesting.

content.title: Recovery from misunderstanding
content.summary: Use every substantive recovery behavior A–G, but no apology ritual: correct quickly, repair downstream state, preserve provenance and move on.

content.title: G11 real decision case
content.summary: The G11 case tests a full AI-native marketing reorientation and the associated capability and role redesign.

content.title: Founder's provisional view on the G11 case
content.summary: The next step is to capture the leader's provisional answer and supporting evidence before CTRL reveals its own view.

content.title: Public snapshot leakage
content.summary: The repository is public, so Git export must use allowlisted summaries and exclude personal, restricted, secret, and unnecessary internal payloads.

content.title: Git history and erasure
content.summary: Git history retains prior content, conflicting with deletion guarantees for personal or sensitive brain data.

content.title: Intimate data before security re-audit
content.summary: Historical audits found plaintext/encryption, RLS, privileged-function, retention, and deletion gaps; current status must be reverified before deeper personal collection.

content.risk: Relational warmth can cross into deceptive personhood or unhealthy dependence.
content.boundary: Build warm continuity while being unmistakably artificial and never exclusive, needy, or superior to human relationships.

content.title: Dependency audit risk
content.summary: The dependency audit remains unresolved and requires scoped reachability and upgrade review; no blind automatic fix was applied.

content.boundary: The evidence supports architecture and tests; it does not yet prove CTRL improves leaders’ judgement.

content.title: Humane judgement-elicitation research package
content.verdict: Comparative, contextual, user-correctable elicitation is supported; compulsory full ranking and relentless probing are not. CTRL-specific benefit remains to be tested.

content.title: Memory integrity and governed self-healing research package
content.verdict: Use append-only bitemporal evidence, typed epistemic status, rebuildable current views, correction cascades, and governed procedural releases. Longitudinal leader benefit remains unverified.

content.title: Human-AI decision quality research package
content.verdict: Use a soft human-first signal, independent AI assessment, verifiable evidence, reconciliation, abstention, and user-owned choice. Validate with real leaders over time.

content.method: Dependency-aware founder interview with no more than three prompts per batch, immediate strategic receipts, conditional branches, fatigue exits and durable readback before continuation.
content.principle: Founder preferences shape the product hypothesis; target-user burden and value must still be tested.
content.current_gate: G1: proving decision domain, personal scope and first recognition moment.
content.safety_boundary: Trust, erasure, uncalibrated confidence and high-consequence governance are evidence gates rather than preference votes.

promises: Every personal asset must be declared before release.
Product closure is distinct from delete-all Mindmake data.
Active copies and backup/vendor expiry are reported as separate milestones.
Personalized caches are subject-scoped and correction-aware.
User-owned Git copies remain under user control and are disclosed truthfully.
content.architecture: Catalog-pinned, subject-owned, replay-safe erasure and export system with independent verification.
content.implementation_gate: Containment and a complete read-only manifest precede destructive automation.

content.principle: Personal-memory depth is blocked until identity, resource ownership, caches and privileged execution are isolated end to end.
content.containment: Quarantine dormant legacy routes first, then restore only verified owner-scoped flows.
content.release_gate: No new ownerless data, no old-cache access, exact ACL readback, matching deployed source, same-owner smoke tests and guarded monitoring.
content.verification: Use two-client and unauthenticated negative tests at both Data API and deployed function boundaries; a secure outage is the rollback baseline.

content.summary: Every service-role Edge handler is classified and a manifest-enforced authorization contract is specified.
content.boundary: Exact routes and exploit mechanics remain restricted.
promises: Explicit auth mode and gateway state per route
Cryptographically verified identity plus separate resource ownership
No unsigned claims or manual deploy drift

content.caveat: The source's numeric thresholds and generic memory scopes are treated as starting hypotheses; CTRL uses task-specific calibration, provenance, purpose and approval gates.
synthesis: Capture judgement through real contrasts and edits, then compile task-sensitive criteria rather than a static persona.
Keep generation, evaluation, authorization and durable learning as separate layers.
Route retrieval and interview depth adaptively instead of making everything agentic or exhaustive.
